newsitem.title: philippines: Manila shares close lower in sympathy with Dow.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares close lower in sympathy with Dow.

text.p: * Value turnover large at 3.8 billion pesos
The Manila share index tumbled 57.44 points, or 1.82 percent, to close at 3,104.77 points on Thursday, continuing a reaction to the Dow's sharp losses, traders said.

"There was really a bloodbath at the exchange today. Everything is down and hardly anything is green and the one thing that's affecting the market is the Dow," said Irving Ackerman, president at I. Ackerman & Co Inc.
